plan.summary: Fix 5 security vulnerabilities found by Codex audit: remove JWT decode-only fallback (auth bypass), disable MockEnabled in prod, add internal API key for ChatAnalysis service-to-service auth, add localhost/API key gate on WapCRM bridge, add SSRF protection on callback URLs.
plan.q_intent: Codex bişeyler buldu. incele yorumla — hepsini yapmak için plan yap. onaylıyorum hemen implementasyona geç
plan.interview_notes: Q approved all 5 fixes immediately. MockEnabled=false applied to prod config and Backend restarted as emergency measure before code changes.

files_changed.change: Removed 4 decode-only JWT fallbacks, added internal API key + IP whitelist auth on /api/v1/chat/analyze proxy, added localhost/API key auth on WapCRM bridge, extracted webhookIpSet to outer scope
Added comment documenting X-Internal-Api-Key header injection via HttpClient registration
Added internal API key validation on /api/v1/analyze, added SSRF protection (IsAllowedCallbackUrl) rejecting private/loopback/link-local IPs in ChatServerURL

verification_questions.question: Are all 4 decode-only JWT fallback paths fully removed with no remaining ReadJwtToken calls that skip signature validation?
Does the token exchange endpoint correctly return 503 when InmaAuth:SecretKey is not configured instead of accepting unsigned tokens?
Does the internal API key validation in ChatAnalysis correctly reject requests when key is configured but header is missing or wrong?
Does the SSRF protection correctly block all RFC 1918 private ranges (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x), loopback, and link-local addresses?
Does the WapCRM bridge auth gate correctly allow localhost requests while blocking external unauthorized requests?

intentional_exclusions: Test coverage for security fixes (tracked separately)

user_facing_errors: 503 INMA auth not configured when SecretKey is empty
400 ChatServerURL points to a disallowed address (SSRF)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All rejection paths return explicit HTTP error responses with error codes. No silent swallowing.

aha_moments.user_pain: Unsigned JWT tokens could be forged to impersonate any tenant or admin
aha_moments.suggestion: Decode-only fallback removed — all JWT paths now require cryptographic signature validation
aha_moments.aha_moment: Admin realizes forged tokens are now instantly rejected instead of silently accepted

aha_moments.user_pain: MockEnabled left on in production allows passwordless admin access
aha_moments.suggestion: MockEnabled disabled in prod config, Backend restarted immediately
aha_moments.aha_moment: Q sees mock-login returning 503 in prod — no more accidental open doors

aha_moments.user_pain: ChatAnalysis endpoint exposed without auth allows cost abuse via Claude API
aha_moments.suggestion: X-Internal-Api-Key header required for service-to-service calls
aha_moments.aha_moment: Unauthorized Claude API calls are blocked before they consume tokens

aha_moments.user_pain: Callback URL in ChatServerURL could be attacker-controlled, leaking auth tokens via SSRF
aha_moments.suggestion: Private IP, loopback, and link-local addresses blocked in callback URL validation
aha_moments.aha_moment: Attacker's SSRF attempt returns 400 instead of leaking internal service tokens

aha_moments.user_pain: WapCRM bridge endpoint accessible from public internet without authentication
aha_moments.suggestion: Localhost and internal API key gate added to WapCRM bridge
aha_moments.aha_moment: External requests to bridge endpoint are rejected with 401 while Automation service calls succeed

verdict.raw_text: CQ1-CQ7 PASS, CQ8 FAIL (intentional breaking change - security hardening), CoVe Q1-Q5 all PASS. Q FORCE PASS: CQ8 is expected for auth hardening.

CQ1.evidence: All auth gates return explicit error responses with codes

CQ2.evidence: No silent failures, all rejections logged and returned

CQ3.evidence: Changes scoped to auth hardening only

CQ8.evidence: Q FORCE PASS: breaking auth changes are intentional security fixes

Q2.reasoning: Token exchange returns 503 when SecretKey missing

Q5.reasoning: WapCRM bridge allows localhost, blocks external
